headline: NNPC and Central Bank of Nigeria Sign Agreement to Strengthen FX Inflows
summary: NNPC Limited signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Central Bank of Nigeria to boost foreign exchange inflows and stabilize the naira currency.
why: NNPC is Nigeria's primary export revenue earner. FX cooperation with the central bank directly influences local currency stability and sovereign reserves.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Coordination between NNPC and CBN aims to stabilize external liquidity and support currency values.
